Metadata.title: Fogata — stories around the fire
Metadata.description: A warm home for long-form stories. Read, write and share around the campfire.

Home.title: Pull up a seat. Someone is telling a story.
Home.lede: Fogata is a warm home for long-form writing. No ads, no feeds built to keep you scrolling, just stories and the people who tell them.
Home.empty: No stories yet. Run npm run db:seed to light the first fire.

Profile.storyCount: {count, plural, =0 {No stories} one {# story} other {# stories}}

Auth.title: Sign in to Fogata
Auth.subtitle: No passwords. We'll email you a link that signs you in.
Auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It expires in one hour.
Auth.terms: By continuing you agree to treat others around the fire with care.
Auth.errorBody: Sign-in links expire after an hour and work once. Request a new one below.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

Validation.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Footer.tagline: A .org, not an ad network. No ads, no selling data, no dark patterns.
Footer.rights: Stories belong to the people who wrote them.
Footer.support: Fogata runs on donations. Ways to support it are coming soon.

NotFound.title: This trail goes cold
NotFound.body: We couldn't find that page. It may have moved, or the link may be mistyped.

Design.title: Style guide
Design.lede: The living reference for Fogata's tokens and components. Switch themes in the header to check every pairing.
Design.readingSample: Reading comes first. Typography, speed and calm beat feature count. The line you are reading is set at the same size, leading and measure as a story body, so it should sit comfortably between 65 and 75 characters.
Design.flameCaption: The flame flickers gently and holds still when reduced motion is on.
Design.vocabularyNote: Spanish UI uses the Spanish terms; English UI uses the English terms. First use always explains the plain meaning.
Design.imageSearchNote: Writers pick cover and inline photos from Unsplash. Picking a photo tells Unsplash it was used and credits the photographer under the image.

Unsplash.title: Free photos from Unsplash
Unsplash.description: Pick a photo for your story. The photographer is credited automatically.
Unsplash.idle: Search for a photo, or start with one of these:
Unsplash.empty: No photos for “{query}”. Try another word.
Unsplash.notConfigured: Photo search isn't set up yet.
Unsplash.rateLimited: We've reached Unsplash's hourly limit. Try again a little later.
Unsplash.error: Photo search isn't working right now. Try again in a moment.

Publish.coverHint: A cover makes your story stand out when shared. Optional.
